method: Visual inspection of actual browser screenshots; separate from geometry tests
initial_mobile: Forest readable but ochre river not confidently traceable; rejected for readability
bounded_correction: Widen channel .34 to .46, move crowns outward, reduce crown radius, use stylized teal, raise camera
final_mobile: Continuous winding teal channel identifiable between two forest banks; whole chest and canopies fully framed
open_view: Hollow cavity and complete lid/latch framed. Hinge attachment reads subtly but ten source contact pairs are independently verified
limitations: Simplified sparse rounded canopies and flat banks
Stylized water color, not physical Amazon sediment color
No photoreal equivalence or physical-phone performance claim
